name: @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy
description: MolVis plugin: JupyterLite pyodide-kernel + molpy notebook

scripts.prebuild: npm run pack:local-py && npm run pack:py && npm run pack:notebooks
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run pack:local-py && npm run pack:py && npm run pack:notebooks
scripts.pretest: npm run pack:local-py && npm run pack:py && npm run pack:notebooks
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:py && npm run test && npm run test:py && npm run build
scripts.pack:notebooks:
node -e "const f=require('fs'),d='src/notebooks/',n=f.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.ipynb')).sort();f.writeFileSync(d+'generated.ts','/* generated from '+n.join(', ')+' by pack:notebooks */
'+n.map(x=>'export const '+x.replace('.ipynb','').toUpperCase()+'_IPYNB = '+f.readFileSync(d+x,'utf8').trim()+' as const;').join('
')+'
')"
